rateDefinitions.winRateValid: wins / (wins + losses + draws); primary rate, invalid error games reported separately
rateDefinitions.winRateAllRecorded: wins / (wins + losses + draws + errors); unplayed games are pending, never wins
rateDefinitions.winRateDecisive: wins / (wins + losses); excludes both draws and errors; null when no decisive games

scope: New bot vs previous stable bot; 3 map/seed scenarios with swapped spawns. No human performance claim.
